{
  "verdict": "PARTIAL",
  "coverage": 0.55,
  "agreement": 0.35,
  "one_line": "Qualitative DeepONet behavior and speedup reproduced; key accuracy claims not reproduced.",
  "justification": "C1 is qualitatively supported (surrogate captures damping trends and E(t) envelope), and C4 is broadly consistent (sub-ms/100-case inference vs 1.48 ms; same order). However, C2 is not reproduced: mean test rel-L2 0.183 vs 0.0083 (≈20–30× worse). C3 and the multi-mode regime are untested, and C5 is only qualitatively evidenced without a clear held-out-temperature protocol matching the paper. Lack of access to the original Gkeyll dataset and substantial deviations in architecture/training budget plus a coarse VP solver (12% damping-rate error) materially weaken quantitative comparability."
}

parsed_verdict.justification: C1 is qualitatively supported (surrogate captures damping trends and E(t) envelope), and C4 is broadly consistent (sub-ms/100-case inference vs 1.48 ms; same order). However, C2 is not reproduced: mean test rel-L2 0.183 vs 0.0083 (≈20–30× worse). C3 and the multi-mode regime are untested, and C5 is only qualitatively evidenced without a clear held-out-temperature protocol matching the paper. Lack of access to the original Gkeyll dataset and substantial deviations in architecture/training budget plus a coarse VP solver (12% damping-rate error) materially weaken quantitative comparability.
